notes.title: Hotfix - inaccessible Special Areas.
notes.content:
Changelog:

-Fixed 2 inaccessible Special Areas.

We wanted to thank our biggest fan, Brandon, for helping us with his amateur patch.

We also wanted to say that LOCIS probably won't get big updates for a long time, as our focus now is on other projects and mainly our private lives as well.
As always, we thank your support and hope to see you in the dark hallways of the UBEL's labyrinth! :)

notes.title: Update 1.1!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/En5Z3oM.jpg[/img]
In the last 6 months (after the release of LOCIS from early access) we have worked a lot on this update, it is a very big update, full of contents that we can't wait to let you discover!
Many of you have shown us that you are very fond of our game, and this thing has given us the strength to continue developing this update, despite all the commitments of daily life. Without getting lost in further chatter, let's proceed to talk a little about this 1.1!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tXGBfiY.png[/img]

[b]The biggest[/b] news is definitely the new [u]collectibles[/u] and [u]cheats[/u] system!
How does it work you are wondering? 
The system is very simple, from now on in the vast world of LOCIS (Classic mode only) you can find collectibles hidden almost everywhere. For every 4 collectibles found, the game will unlock a cheat in the cheats menu (found in the extras menu of the main menu).
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/qJsstBqBSaZMYREOmZ/giphy.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/99Uls9B.jpg[/img]
Obviously in the screen, all the cheats are still locked, this is because we don't want to spoil the surprise of discovering them for yourself! Once any cheat has been unlocked, you can activate and deactivate it as you wish from this menu (you can also activate several cheats together).

Among the biggest innovations we obviously also have [u][b]2 new Areas[/b][/u]. 
For the first area you can find the screens below:
[url=https://i.imgur.com/Pcphl9g]Screenshot 1[/url]
[url=https://imgur.com/fBKj6xL]Screenshot 2[/url]
[url=https://imgur.com/5w2Pvug]Screenshot 3[/url]
[url=https://imgur.com/AznldQi]Screenshot 4[/url]
[url=https://imgur.com/xvseoJc]Screenshot 5[/url]

The second new Area is [b]secret[/b] and can be found in a very particular way...
who knows, maybe by dying with very bad karma you will have a chance to see it eheh.

[previewyoutube=AQjsF3knMec;full][/previewyoutube]
Last but not least, we also leave you a brand new trailer created to celebrate the release of this update!
Furthermore, we have made the decision to permanently lower the price of the game to [u][b]$4.99[/b][/u], we did it both because the game has now been out for 1 year, but also to facilitate hypothetical new buyers in diving into the dark world of LOCIS.


 
|Build Ver 1.1 Changelog| 
 
Added: 
- 2 new Areas for the game 
- New Collectibles system 
- Cheats system in the "Extras" menu 
- New negative karma rare event 
- New Special Areas for "Classic" Gamemode 
- New story papers (lore messages). 
 
Other: 
-Fixed minor bugs 
-Improved game stability. 
 
The update is now live!

notes.title: Update 1.0!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ob2sE9F.jpg[/img]
After 3 months of release on Steam, we have been working hard to bring the game to the most complete state possible as soon as possible, and we are happy to finally announce its [b]exit from the Early Access state! [/b]
With this update we wanted to make the game as stable as possible by improving its strengths and correcting the critical issues... speaking of the strengths, we wanted to make a recap of the 3 main gamemodes of the game, which have been developed and improved throughout the Early Access period.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/Y9JgltD.png[/img]
Let's start talking about [b]CLASSIC MODE[/b]. The Classic Mode of LOCIS actually is the story mode of the game. In this mode, players will be able to adventure into the dark world by discovering its plots and subplots, and will also be able to make choices that will affect the game by bringing it to 3 different endings.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Wk1JIHk.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/8T9Zw1D.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/FY9rrum.gif[/img]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/1fGJWpw.png[/img]
Carrying on [b]ARCADE MODE[/b]... this mode was created thinking of the most competitive players in our community, in fact this mode objective is to accumulate points or try to win as fast as possible. Players will be able to freely decide whether to compete to make the best times or to make the best scores (or both) and compete worldwide thanks to the introduction of the [b]Leaderboard[/b].
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/ps7LXAnQXs5Ojia9E6/giphy.gif[/img][img]https://media.giphy.com/media/lez7uik5cDlEdwS9a1/giphy.gif[/img][img]https://media.giphy.com/media/rjMY3lGQZTIzcU21xM/giphy.gif[/img][img]https://media.giphy.com/media/0xci3rXRUQ3NAhLdJH/giphy.gif[/img]



[img]https://i.imgur.com/DbDKUCV.png[/img]
Last but not least, we talk about [b]TRIP MODE[/b], what exactly is this mode? In our opinion it's a mode that will increase the replayability of LOCIS, without too many words it's a gamemode in which all the areas of the classic mode are mixed together, moreover everything has been mixed by adding "out of the ordinary" elements, we will let the players find out what strange situations we have prepared for them!
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/ghlspcK8IGLpzzRM3B/giphy.gif[/img]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/UzvzPrw.png[/img]
Finally, we would like to talk about the improvements.
Among the most important improvements of this update we have fixed many bugs, the game is now [b]more stable than ever[/b]... besides this we have also reworked the Main Menu (which we will let you discover), added many rare events and we have also prepared new [u]achievements and Steam cards [/u](with attached rewards such as wallpapers and emojis) but these will become available once steam has completed the verification checks!
Regarding the future of the game, we will now take a little break, but we can't wait to get back to work as soon as possible to create new Areas, new features and improve the game experience more and more!

In conclusion we wish you a Merry Christmas and we look forward to seeing you in the hallways of the vast and dark world of LOCIS!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/6gakj8W.png[/img]


[b]The update is now live![/b]

notes.title: Update |Build ver 0.9|
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/1fGJWpw.png[/img]

Let's start talking about [b]ARCADE MODE[/b], what exactly is this mode? This mode was created thinking of the most competitive players in our community, in fact this mode objective is to accumulate points or try to win as fast as possible. Players will be able to freely decide whether to compete to make the best times or to make the best scores (or both) and compete worldwide thanks to the introduction of the [b]Leaderboard[/b] (more details in the section below).
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/ps7LXAnQXs5Ojia9E6/giphy.gif[/img][img]https://media.giphy.com/media/lez7uik5cDlEdwS9a1/giphy.gif[/img][img]https://media.giphy.com/media/rjMY3lGQZTIzcU21xM/giphy.gif[/img][img]https://media.giphy.com/media/0xci3rXRUQ3NAhLdJH/giphy.gif[/img]
[u]The mode must be unlock by beating the game in Explorer or Nightmare.[/u]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tXGBfiY.png[/img]

Among the new features, the most important are the addition of [u]Leaderboards and the new Area.[/u]
Regarding the [b]Leaderboards[/b], the game from now on will register the records of all players and dynamically build a competition based on them... it will also be possible to filter by time or by score your own (or global) results.
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/rDbCXqfeyqXh4bFmvI/giphy.gif[/img]

The new [b]Area[/b] of ​​this update is very special since it will deepen the main lore of the game and give new ideas and interpretations. To avoid spoilers, for those who want, we will leave some screenshots of the Area below:
[url=https://imgur.com/2j5CsOM]Screenshot 1[/url]
[url=https://imgur.com/yZbdCqr]Screenshot 2[/url]
[url=https://imgur.com/04WuxTz]Screenshot 3[/url]
[url=https://imgur.com/Gpr8iSf]Screenshot 4[/url]
[url=https://imgur.com/9jjAzAQ]Screenshot 5[/url]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/UzvzPrw.png[/img]

With each update, we as developers work hard to ensure the delivery of an even better gaming experience and for this 0.9 we wanted to improve the Trip mode (added in the last update) and the animations of the scroll hud.

Regarding the Trip mode we have added some pills that, if ingested, will give strange effects to the player's view... in our opinion these new pickups will increase the sense of the mode making it even more strange and interesting to play. Below you will find some examples:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/T2HiZJphtHojc6mFaY/giphy.gif[/img]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/iZGiRU9tJklnGsUhtZ/giphy.gif[/img]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/16iuRfdnHVUM7sF3bo/giphy.gif[/img]
As for the improvement of the scroll hud, we have made the animation of use more nice and cured:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/ji4RdN5oIZthjnbOdM/giphy.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/60AVorG.png[/img]
As it was for halloween, we also decided to participate to the [b]Steam Autumn Sale[/b]. As always, our intent is to build an ever larger community around our game!
Last but not least, we really wanted to thank our betatesters for their contribution in improving the game and we also thank all the players who are filling the Community Hub with LOCIS screenshots, fanarts and videos... 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/6gakj8W.png[/img]




[b]|Build Ver 0.9 Changelog|[/b]

Added:
- New Area for the game
- New Gamemode: "Arcade"
- Leaderboards for Arcade mode in the new "Extras" menu of the main menu
- New Special Areas for "Classic" Gamemode
- New Sound Effects
- New story papers (lore messages).

Improved:
- Trip Mode now have the pills that give some special effect to the player's view
- Hud animation for the scrolls
- The Patrol Robot of the Laboratory Area now is bigger (to do damage to the player more clearly)
- The skeleton model (Egypt and Visceral Areas) now has many variations
- Removed Anubis from Trip Mode, as he could rarely block the player and very easily interpenetrate with objects in the hallways.

Other:
-Fixed minor bugs
-Improved game stability.


[b]The update is now live![/b]

notes.title: Update |Build ver 0.8|
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/DbDKUCV.png[/img]
Let's start talking about [b]TRIP MODE[/b], what exactly is this mode? In our opinion it's a mode that will increase the replayability of LOCIS, without too many words it's a gamemode in which all the areas of the classic mode are mixed together, moreover everything has been mixed by adding "out of the ordinary" elements, we will let the players find out what strange situations we have prepared for them!
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/ghlspcK8IGLpzzRM3B/giphy.gif[/img]
[u]The mode must be unlocked by winning the game in Classic Mode while visiting at least 8 or more areas.[/u]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/tXGBfiY.png[/img]

Among the new features, the most important are certainly the [b]new map generation capabilities[/b] that we have implemented to the game algorithm.
We have added new varieties of rooms that the game can generate, here are some examples:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/V0F8joO7cK1WPBIYYN/giphy.gif[/img]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/672xUlJecTge83ptoj/giphy.gif[/img]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/emSviamf6TPoqE3ad6/giphy.gif[/img]

We have also added new types of "connectors", [b]the hallway can now branch off[/b]:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/knjupmxB6RgTM7HFu1/giphy.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/UzvzPrw.png[/img]

Since 0.7.2 the game has received many improvements in terms of stability, we have fixed many bugs and tried to improve the balance, adding new filters for the "Explorer" difficulty.
We have also worked on a [b]major rework relating to the "Apartments" Area[/b], improving the graphics adapting it to the quality standard of the other Areas:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/qNeQlcH.jpg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/CMWaXlQ.jpg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/2GWFff1.jpg[/img]
We have also added (like every update) a [b]new Area[/b], but we prefer not to spoiler it, we will let the players discover it by playing... however if anyone is interested, can find some screenshoots in the September status report: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1394830/announcements/detail/2898586082492327487]CLICK HERE[/url][img]https://i.imgur.com/W4QGW2M.png[/img]

Halloween is upon us! We have decided to participate to the [b]Steam Halloween Sale[/b], so the game will have a [u]discount[/u] in the coming days, we did it to encourage new players to try our game in order to expand our community, stay tuned!
We also want to thank all the support received so far, for any doubt or info we will be available on all social networks (including steam).




[b]|Build Ver 0.8 Changelog|[/b]

Added:
- New Area for the game
- New Gamemode: "Trip"
- New Special Areas for "Classic" Gamemode
- New types of room the game can generates
- The hallway can now branch off in other directions
- Rework of the models of "Apartments" Area
- New Sound Effects
- New Music Tracks
- New story papers (lore messages).

Other:
-Fixed minor bugs
-Improved game stability.

[u][b]The update is now live![/b][/u]

notes.title: Update |Build ver 0.7.2|
notes.content:
|Build ver 0.7.2 Changelog|

- Added Pixelation level, you can choose the amount of pixelization of the game (even disabling it completely)
- Improved monster spawn balance (now it limit the spawn rate of the monsters in case of slow gameplay)
- Improved the monster of Egypt Area, now he is more "indulgent" with the player if it has Good Karma
- Minor bug fixes.


We wanted to thank all the feedback we have been receiving in the last few weeks, we will do our best to improve the game experience and add new content!
